fields.statement: QA at 1021835c with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) in a fresh rhiza init repo, driving `rhiza tui app request` in a real tmux pty: the form drew a Kind Select (Feature, Bug, Milestone; Feature default) and a Request TextArea. Picking Bug and pressing Enter on empty text showed '✗ A request needs its text' and queued nothing. Typing '--json output   is wrong' and Enter printed the queued request JSON (kind bug, text '--json output is wrong', whitespace collapsed, dash-leading text kept) and exited 0; `rhiza request ls --json` listed it queued. Picking Milestone and submitting 'VM milestone' queued kind milestone. Typing 'dark mode' then Esc exited 0 and queued nothing. `tui app request --once` exits 2 with 'has no --once'; the old name `tui app requests` exits 4 'unknown app'. go test -trimpath ./internal/tui/requestapp/... and ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(tui-request-app|rex-install)$|TestRequestsApp' pass.
